name: REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW
shortDescription: Force a materialized view to pick up new data now
syntax: REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW [IF EXISTS] view_name [WITH SCHEDULE NOW]
description: Refresh a materialized view immediately: the changelog indices are refreshed and the enrich policies re-executed - exactly the work the view's watcher performs on a schedule. Use it on a cluster where Watcher is unavailable, or to make a change visible without waiting for the next refresh interval. Requires the Materialized Views extension (softclient4es-extensions) on the engine that executes the statement: an engine without it rejects the statement at execution time with `Unsupported table DDL statement`.

clauses.name: IF EXISTS
clauses.description: Do not raise an error when the view does not exist.

clauses.name: WITH SCHEDULE NOW
clauses.description: Also schedule the view's transforms for immediate execution instead of waiting for their next run.

examples.title: Refresh a view
examples.description: Re-run the changelogs and enrich policies

examples.title: Refresh and schedule now
examples.sql: REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW orders_with_customers_mv WITH SCHEDULE NOW

examples.title: Refresh if it exists
examples.description: No error when the view is absent
examples.sql: REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW IF EXISTS orders_with_customers_mv

notes: Requires the Materialized Views extension - an engine without it parses the statement and then rejects it at execution time
This is the documented manual equivalent of the view's watcher, and the supported path on a cluster whose licence does not include Watcher
limitations: A single-table view deploys no enrich policy and no watcher, so it has nothing to re-execute here - it is refreshed by its own transform on its REFRESH EVERY schedule
